results.question: 每个商品品类下各有多少个商品？
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  COUNT(p.id) AS product_count
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN products AS p
  ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY
  c.id,
  c.name
ORDER BY
  c.id
results.executed_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories AS c LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 200

results.question: 每个品类的成交总金额分别是多少？成交金额按明细数量乘以成交单价计算。
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
    c.name AS category_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN products AS p
    ON p.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY
    c.id,
    c.name
ORDER BY
    total_transaction_amount DESC
results.executed_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_transaction_amount FROM categories AS c LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: 按毛利（成交单价减去成本，再乘以数量）计算，毛利最高的品类是哪个？给出品类名和毛利。
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.quantity) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 1
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.quantity) AS gross_profit
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories AS c
    ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY
    c.id,
    c.name
ORDER BY
    gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
results.executed_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.quantity) AS gross_profit FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY gross_profit DESC LIMIT 1
